summary: HPS Corporate Lending Fund filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 disclosing monthly distributions, NAV per share, and continuous offering status rather than any special situation. The Fund declared regular and variable supplemental distributions for its four share classes, with net totals ranging from $0.1819 to $0.1990 per share, payable to holders of record September 30, 2026, and paid on or about October 30, 2026. NAV per share as of August 31, 2026 was $24.45 across all classes, with aggregate NAV of $12,264.6 million. The continuous offering of up to $15.0 billion remains ongoing, with $14,273.9 million sold.
